The '''Apex Society''' was a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Collan Eislo]].

==History==
The Apex Society was made up mainly of bored nobles who sought to be able to use the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and use the knowledge of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to enhance their notoriety. Some of them also believed that Collan Eislo, their leader, was guided by the spirits of deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], such as [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Eislo believed that if he obtained the [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]] of the ancient Sith Lord [[Darth Nihilus]], he would be able to use the Force, so he determined to find it and promised the members of the Apex Society that he would become their master, once he had obtained the artifact.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus">''{{WizCite|story=The Mask of Darth Nihilus|book=The Unknown Regions}}''</ref>

Eislo and the Society eventually traced the artifact to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]], and traveled there to look for it.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
